    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    AlertNotifier
    Handles budget alert notifications for the Masroofy application.
    AuthController
    Manages user authentication and PIN security for the Masroofy application.
    AuthScreen
    Handles the authentication screen for the Masroofy application.
    BudgetCycle
    Represents a budget cycle in the Masroofy application.
    Category
    Represents an expense category in the Masroofy budgeting system.
    CategoryTotal
    Simple data holder that pairs a Category name with its total spending.
    DashboardController
    Controller class responsible for managing dashboard operations.
    DashboardScreen
    View class responsible for displaying the main dashboard screen.
    ExpenseEntryScreen
    Handles the expense entry screen for the Masroofy application.
    HistoryController
    Manages transaction history and budget cycle data for the Masroofy application.
    HistoryScreen
    Handles the expense history screen for the Masroofy application.
    LimitEngine
    Calculates and manages the safe daily spending limit for the Masroofy application.
    Main
    Entry point for the Masroofy budget management application.
    SecurityConfig
    Stores and manages the security configuration for the Masroofy application.
    Settingcontroller
    Handles user settings and app-level configuration for the Masroofy application.
    SettingScreen
    Handles the settings screen for the Masroofy application.
    SetupController
    Manages the creation, loading, and validation of budget cycles for the Masroofy application.
    SetupScreen
    Handles the budget setup screen for the Masroofy application.
    StatsScreen
    Handles the spending statistics screen for the Masroofy application.
    Transaction
    Represents a single expense transaction in the Masroofy budgeting system.
